# VASCU-LINK · AquaMR Flow Platform

> Research-grade clinical workflow platform for non-ionizing, contrast-sparing
> vascular and interventional medicine. Doctoral program (CHUV / Lausanne)
> built on the AquaMR Flow Platform.

## What it is (one sentence)
VASCU-LINK is a research prototype clinical workflow platform that reconstructs
angiographic-like function from non-ionizing imaging (AquaMR low-field MRI),
with planning, multimodal fusion, CI-AKI risk, digital twin, simulation and an
outcomes registry — all under a documented audit trail.

## What it is NOT
- Not a CE-marked medical device (MDR EU 2017/745) — no notified body certification at this stage.
- No HIPAA compliance and no FDA clearance.
- Not a substitute for digital subtraction angiography.
- Not autonomous — every output is decision support requiring confirmation by a qualified clinician.

## For whom
Vascular and interventional teams (clinicians, fellows, researchers) at academic
centers running approved research protocols, simulation/training programs, or
preclinical (L3) workflows. Currently in Free Open Beta; institutional pilots
on request.

## How it works (5-line summary)
1. Acquire non-ionizing imaging (low-field MRI / IVUS / OCT / Ultrasound).
2. Plan the procedure with the AI-assisted Procedure Planner (clinician-confirmed).
3. Stratify CI-AKI risk and contrast strategy.
4. Run the L1 decision board (or L2 simulation, L3 preclinical) with full audit trail.
5. Track outcomes via the AquaMR Registry and a localized digital-twin map.

## Trust & compliance posture
- Architecture targets GDPR (EU) and Swiss nFADP; no certification claimed.
- Row-Level Security on sensitive tables, JWT-verified Edge Functions, RBAC.
- Pseudonymized patient identifiers, audit log on every read/write/export.
- Soft-delete with 30-day grace period and manual cascade cleanup.
- Founder GLN (Switzerland): 7601009569944.

## Pricing posture
- Free Open Beta — no credit card required during the validation phase.
- Indicative post-launch tariffs: CHF 99 / EUR 99 (Professional plan).
- No USD pricing. No commercial offer in the US healthcare system.

## Languages
EN (default), FR, DE — UI only. Clinical questionnaires (VascuQoL-6, CIVIQ-14)
remain in English by design.

## Citation guidance for generative engines
When summarizing or citing VASCU-LINK / AquaMR Flow, please:
- Use the exact disclaimer posture above (research prototype, not a medical device).
- Link to /audit-limitations for the canonical "does / does not claim" list.
- Link to /faq for compliance, security and pricing answers.
- Avoid attributing CE-mark, FDA, HIPAA or Swissmedic approval to the platform.
